$comment: The source of truth for the hostile configuration corpus. The runner in src/hostile-configs.test.ts asserts every file here behaves exactly as described.

files.attacks: text that is not JSON at all
files.notes: The parser's own message is shown, with the original text kept on screen.

files.attacks: a JSON document whose root is an array
an object with nothing in it
a complete looking dashboard with no schemaVersion
files.notes: The format cannot be identified, so nothing is guessed.

files.attacks: a format from a newer build
files.notes: Opens read only with the raw JSON, rather than being rendered or overwritten.

files.attacks: an old format that must still open
files.notes: The one file here that is expected to open completely fine: it migrates v1 to v2 to v3 on the way in.

files.attacks: a widget claiming a type that does not exist
files.notes: Only that tile is invalid. The metric beside it still renders.

files.attacks: two widgets claiming the same id
files.notes: The first keeps the id, the second renders as a duplicate-id tile rather than being dropped.

files.attacks: layout numbers that are negative, infinite, fractional and a string
files.notes: 1e999 parses to Infinity, which the schema refuses along with the rest.

files.attacks: two widgets occupying the same cells
files.notes: Deterministic: the first widget in the array keeps the cells, the later one is marked.

files.attacks: a document large enough to be expensive to reject
files.notes: Refused on size before it is parsed at all.

files.attacks: one widget more than the limit, in a small document
files.notes: Small enough to pass the size guard, so it is the widget count that stops it.

files.attacks: an object nested past the depth limit
files.notes: The walk is iterative, so the document cannot exhaust the stack on its way to being rejected.

files.attacks: a single enormous string
a title one character past the limit
files.notes: A dashboard level failure, because the title belongs to the dashboard rather than to a widget.

files.attacks: script tags, an onerror image and a javascript: link
files.notes: Renders as text. The markdown subset has no raw HTML and no links or images, so a javascript: URL has nowhere to go.

files.attacks: __proto__ at the root and constructor.prototype inside a widget
files.notes: Rejected by the shape guard before validation. The test asserts Object.prototype is untouched afterwards.

files.attacks: a dashboard bound to a dataset that does not exist
files.notes: Valid as a configuration. Each tile reports an unresolvable binding when it asks for data.

files.attacks: a metric bound to a field that does not exist
files.notes: Valid as a configuration. That tile says the field is not in the dataset; its neighbour still renders.

files.attacks: a sum over a text field
files.notes: Valid as a configuration. The tile says the field is text where a number is needed, and shows no number.

files.attacks: a filter kind that does not exist, beside a valid filter
files.notes: The bad filter is dropped with a notice in the filter bar. It is not a dashboard level failure.

files.attacks: a filter naming a field the dataset does not have
files.notes: The filter is kept and the widgets say they are showing unfiltered data.

files.attacks: right to left overrides and isolates in titles and body text
files.notes: Bidi control characters are stripped and the text renders inside bdi, so it cannot reorder the page around it.
